long_biography.plain_text:
From Suqian in Jiangsu province, Richard Qiangdong Liu earned a sociology degree from Renmin University of China and later an EMBA from China Europe International Business School. He opened an electronics shop in Beijing in 1998, shifted the business online in 2004 and built JD.com into a major e-commerce, logistics and technology group. Liu served as chief executive until April 2022 and remains founder and chairman; Forbes classifies his e-commerce fortune as self-made.

His recent maritime interests go beyond private yacht ownership. Forbes reported in March 2026 that Liu had personally invested almost $700 million in Sea Expandary, a new brand intended to make smaller, environmentally minded boats more affordable, while leaving daily operations to its own chief executive.
